def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    euro_amount = 200_000 * 90
    initial_six_month_forward_ask = 1.3983 - 19.0 / 10_000
    current_three_month_forward_bid = 1.4106 - 21.6 / 10_000
    usd_libor = 0.01266
    remaining_years = 3 / 12

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    termination_value = (
        (current_three_month_forward_bid - initial_six_month_forward_ask)
        * euro_amount
        / (1 + usd_libor * remaining_years)
    )
    answer = round(termination_value, 1)

    # return answer
    return answer
